remarks: This apartment is located on the East Banks apartment building located directly on the Norwalk River. East Banks is a 12-unit apartment building with an elevator near the main lobby. Only three apartments per floor. This apartment is located on the third floor and is an end-unit. The apartment is open and light-filled with views of the river from the living room and bedroom. Large bedroom with walk-in closet. Full bath can be accessed via the bedroom or from the living room. Laundry room in the actual apartment with full size washer and dryer. Central air and gas heat. Two-month security deposit required (if 62 years old or older, only one month security deposit required). Tenant must have good credit and references. Must have acceptable background check. Tenant must have proof of adequate income to support the monthly rent. No pets- no exceptions. Tenant pays heat and hot water (gas), electricity, cable & internet (if desired). Floor plan shown in photos is a reverse of the actual apartment.
